name: National Weather Service API
tagline: Official US government weather forecasts, alerts, and observations — free, no API key.
description: The National Weather Service (NWS) API at api.weather.gov provides authoritative US weather data including forecasts, active weather alerts, observations, and radar. It is a free public service of the US federal government with no API key required. Clients must identify themselves with a descriptive User-Agent header. Data covers the United States and territories.

auth.details: No API key required. A descriptive User-Agent header (app name and contact) is required per NWS terms; requests without it may be blocked.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public government API; no paid plans. Fair-use rate limiting applies.

rate_limits: not published as fixed numbers; fair-use throttling — avoid excessive concurrent requests
use_cases: get forecast for US lat/lon coordinates
fetch active weather alerts by state or zone
resolve lat/lon to NWS grid point and forecast office
get current observations from a weather station
list forecast discussion text products for a WFO
